# Fallout 76 Seasonal Event Guide: Mischief Night

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Oct 1, 2025
- 6 min read

Updated: Oct 8, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_42312c54f07d4b8cb418c28c05353050~mv2.jpg)

With thanks to Cofffee888 and SugarBombsRADS.

**SUBJECT TO CHANGE WHEN PORTING TO LIVE SERVERS**

Rampage through Rapidan Camp! A rowdy Eyebot called JES-2R is leading a crew of mischief-makers to wreak havoc on Rapidan Camp. I should call upon my most wicked instincts for the occasion... and bring a good disguise!

This event will be a permanent seasonal event.

A notification will appear in the top left-hand corner of your screen and in the World Activity tab in the bottom left-hand corner.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c491db5bbfc44820adc8f58f3f27d09f~mv2.jpg)

You don’t need to wear a costume to participate in this event, but it is encouraged.

Note: Since dropping a nuke in Skyline Valley doesn't create a Nuke Zone, you won't need to wear a hazmat suit or Power Armor if someone tries to nuke the event.

The following is recommended to make the event a little bit easier:

- Jetpack torso mod
- Marsupial mutation
- Speed Demon mutation
- Damage Output buffs such as food, chems, and alcohol.
- __Max AP__ and__AP Regen__ Food Buffs
- __Energy Resistance__ and__Damage Resistance__ Food Buffs
- Turn off all unrelated event and quest map markers in your pip-boy

This event can be completed solo if you know all the spawn locations and are running a combat build with optimized AP, maximum AP, and AP regeneration.

__Rewards__

Photos of the rewards can be found __here__.

Downloadable and printable reward checklists can be found __here__.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dde64adadf4e4ce98c65c4450276af75~mv2.jpg)

__The Event__

The event is divided into three sections: **Forest**, **Grounds**, and **Helipad**. You need to complete tasks to fill the progress bar before you can move on to the next section.

Each task contributes a set number of points toward filling the progress bar:

| Task | Points per Action | 
| Graffiti Wall | 2 | 
| Light a Bonfire | 2 | 
| Loot a Candy/Treat Bowl | 1.25 | 
| Blow up things (Boxes of Fireworks) | 1 | 
| Fork the Lawn | 0.75 | 
| Kill Lost | 0.75 | 

You can complete tasks in previous areas and still have them count toward the current progress bar. For example, if you’re in Part 2 on the Grounds and you kill Lost in Part 1 in the Forest, it will still contribute to the bar. Just keep an eye on the event radius, as it is centered around JES-2R, who moves throughout the event.

This event functions much like The Big Bloom, using a single 15-minute timer for the entire event rather than separate timers for each stage. Be mindful of how much time you spend in each section. Ideally, aim for no more than 4–5 minutes in the first two sections so you have enough time to complete Section 3. There aren’t many tasks available to fill the progress bar in Section 3, so if time runs out, the event will fail.

__PART 1__

**Sow mayhem in the forest!**

From the spawn in location, run up the hill and light the Mischief Pyre (Starting Pyre).

You have 5 minutes to light the Pyre.

Be cautious when lighting the Pyre. If you jump onto the logs on either side of the fire, you might get stuck between them and will need to fast travel to escape.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a8c00da866854b02bed4526381f4300e~mv2.jpg)

Follow JES-2R from the Starting Pyre to the Forest Pyre while completing the tasks listed below. Because of the short event timer, it’s best to run ahead and complete the tasks instead of keeping pace with him.

__List of tasks for Part 1 - The Forest__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b40eedcf0eef4ab9bb83e19a1eee65b4~mv2.jpg)

__Light the Bonfires__

2 points each

There are 10 bonfires to light.

Most can be found along the dirt track as you make your way downhill.

I’ve created a short video here that shows all spawn locations.

**First 4 Bonfires**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ad1928af3e86490bb175104cf5f03ee9~mv2.jpg)

**Fifth Bonfire**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_715239cd21694d3faa81e29b8c4b7ff0~mv2.jpg)

**Last 5 bonfires**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2900712f371a4e5bb8ececb83bbe7b75~mv2.jpg)

__Blow Things up__

1 point each

Stand well away when shooting to blow things up, especially the boxes of fireworks. The boxes have a large area of attack and will down you if you are too close. Melee weapons can not destroy the firework crates.

Fireworks

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9247dbd7995f4fac8e5a8a0a70f96bef~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f22d25229def4a4f95d5bfa662f14d6a~mv2.jpg)

__Eliminate the enemies__

0.75 points each

Kill the Spooky Lost

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6041b40f30184ef6a399a64ab75d5f2c~mv2.jpg)

**Light the Forest Pyre**

Once the progression bar is full, you have 2 minutes to light the Forest Pyre.

Be cautious when lighting the Pyre. If you jump onto the logs on either side of the fire, you might get stuck between them and will need to fast travel to escape.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_470f6125d75242cab71d245d6f540cd5~mv2.jpg)

__PART 2__

**Sow mayhem in the grounds of Camp Rapidan!**

Follow JES-2R from the Forest Pyre to the Grounds Pyre while completing the following tasks. I would advise running ahead of him and completing the tasks in the area due to the short event timer.

__List of tasks for Part 2 - The Cabins__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c79a46ad2fcb46bbbf1010ff7b7e1731~mv2.jpg)

__Eliminate the enemies__

0.75 points each

Kill the Spooky Lost

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6041b40f30184ef6a399a64ab75d5f2c~mv2.jpg)

__Blow Things up__

1 point each

Stand well away when shooting to blow things up, especially the boxes of fireworks. The boxes have a large area of attack and will down you if you are too close.

Fireworks

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a33209852bca45bc9b30ddf502b40fac~mv2.jpg)

__Raid the trick-or-treat bowls__

1.25 points each

Cooldown period: 20 seconds.

Chance to collect:

- Frag Mine (25% chance)
- Bubblegum
- Cotton Candy Bites
- Gumdrops

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e829d21918064467ae316245d381f3d7~mv2.jpg)

__Graffiti the walls__

2 points each

There are 6 marked locations for you to interact with.

Interact with the wall and select from:

- Spray some gory blood splatters
- Hang a mischievous pumpkin man
- Paint a tribute to the Mothman
- Carve out a grinning skull

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2e4b3621f2f64ff4a7235fdc571c3dd7~mv2.jpg)

Look for either the large paint splatter

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a8c9538db21a482b9e5bc86ba7ce5013~mv2.jpg)

OR

The small platform and stairs

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f76127c39f154b329aeffd2769b70fc5~mv2.jpg)

**Graffiti Walls one and two**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_716e5906b24d42af84946eceea6863f1~mv2.jpg)

**Graffiti Walls three** 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4fed338978bd4f50928c086971f219f1~mv2.jpg)

**Graffiti Walls four**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_12eab7b7e5f847fcbfcadaf38efd07e2~mv2.jpg)

**Graffiti Walls five and six**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_38a2d5cac5144ef08f5aa408c3b50e0a~mv2.jpg)

__Fork the lawns__

0.75 points each

Interact with each box of forks.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5b25d855fd49445599101acd89b91a52~mv2.jpg)

6 boxes of forks are located to the left of the path in the area shown in the photo below.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0f84cc36ccff45918e59e29279f77dc6~mv2.jpg)

6 more boxes of forks are located near the Grounds Pyre, as shown in the photo below.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_78854fc144a94be888ff2e411859979b~mv2.jpg)

**Light the Grounds Pyre**

Once the progression bar is full, you have 2 minutes to light the Grounds Pyre.

Be cautious when lighting the Pyre. If you jump onto the logs on either side of the fire, you might get stuck between them and will need to fast travel to escape.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_79efee9d637243aba4ae0dc807e7890a~mv2.jpg)

__PART 3__

**Sow mayhem near the Landing Pad!**

Follow JES-2R from the GroundsPyre to the Helipad Pyre while completing the following tasks. I would advise running ahead of him and completing the tasks in the area due to the short event timer.

__List of tasks for Part 3 - The Landing Pad__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c66660892f3e4baf96e91b978b32128e~mv2.jpg)

__Eliminate the enemies__

0.75 points each

Kill the Spooky Lost

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6041b40f30184ef6a399a64ab75d5f2c~mv2.jpg)

__Blow Things up__

1 point each

Stand well away when shooting to blow things up, especially the boxes of fireworks. The boxes have a large area of attack and will down you if you are too close.

Fireworks

**Note:** Additional fireworks can be found on the cliffs, along the beach, and in the boats on the lake, but most players will likely destroy these during Section Two on the Grounds.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5934ac0b10bc474eb907170fe6a9c107~mv2.jpg)

Explosive Barrels

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_32cf48a4d98d4036a2de7e9027896224~mv2.jpg)

__Raid the trick-or-treat bowls__

1.25 points each

Cooldown period: 20 seconds.

Chance to collect:

- Frag Mine (25% chance)
- Bubblegum
- Cotton Candy Bites
- Gumdrops

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_eac7a856e50b41a5b9fd3dac02c248a2~mv2.jpg)

__Light the Helipad Pyre__

Once the progression bar is full, you have 2 minutes to light the Helipad Pyre.

Be cautious when lighting the Pyre. If you jump onto the logs on either side of the fire, you might get stuck between them and will need to fast travel to escape.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_070faca32a7549ad916a1935ddf224dd~mv2.jpg)

__PART 4__

__Destroy the Rapidan Elite Security Force.__

The security force consists of three legendary Assaultrons. They’ll explode on death, so stay alert. Aim for their legs to cripple them and make it easier for everyone to bring them down.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_af1049e8bb8a4f85988e311db27f0a9f~mv2.jpg)

__Destroy the Vertibird.__

The Vertibird has 3000 HP. Shoot at it or use Melee weapons to destroy it.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_78382024dc664cf79bc11ecd7efd9b08~mv2.jpg)

**Lost will keep spawning even after the event is completed. Clear the area first before checking your rewards.**
